You must select up to 4 relevant facts from the provided candidate list that have a strong connection to the query, aiding in reasoning and providing an accurate answer. The output should be in JSON format, e.g., {"fact": [["s1", "p1", "o1"], ["s2", "p2", "o2"]]}, and if no facts are relevant, return an empty list, {"fact": []}. You must only use facts from the candidate list and not generate new facts.
